summary: Engineering preview: native Instrument Teal HOME/banks and Groove/Loop/Mix/Click now lead into EDIT for a protected sixteen-slot semantic draft. Numbered chord/timing/voicing/bass/phrase controls, explicit remove confirmation and one-step undo feed the same accompaniment clock; quarter slots, gates/ties and bar-bound groove edits preserve phase. Active and pending plans, real cursor and planned focus stay distinct. Safe stopped-only checkpoints report RAM Pending, verified Checkpoint or Recovered, with checked backup object 75. Factory originals, live Harmony/HOLD and the current manual-take/latest-three policy remain protected. Numbered Songs, chord-library/audition, arranged recording, learning/suggestions, remaining page/motion migration and physical verification are pending.
